summary: The note describes GNU IceCat, a free software rebranded version of the Mozilla Firefox web browser distributed by the GNU Project. It was formerly known as GNU IceWeasel and is stated to be compatible with GNU/Linux, Windows, Android and macOS.
one_line: GNU IceCat is a free software rebranding of Mozilla Firefox distributed by the GNU Project, formerly called GNU IceWeasel.
key_facts: GNU IceCat is a free software rebranding of the Mozilla Firefox web browser.
GNU IceCat is distributed by the GNU Project.
GNU IceCat was formerly known as GNU IceWeasel.
GNU IceCat is compatible with GNU/Linux.
GNU IceCat is compatible with Windows.
GNU IceCat is compatible with Android.
GNU IceCat is compatible with macOS.
